claims.evidence: The nine .raw files deposited in PRIDE file list for PXD009302 that are processed in RPE_APX_txt.zip (txt/summary.txt lists exactly these nine raw files). The two zip archives contain MaxQuant text outputs only, no raw files; P8838.raw is covered in the shotgun SDRF.

Experiment names S1_1..S3_3 appear in txt/summary.txt of RPE_APX_txt.zip and in proteinGroups.txt column names. Mapping to raw files is by identical Peptide Sequences Identified counts per row (P1408=1569=S1_1, P1409=1618=S1_2, P1410=1641=S1_3, P1412=2138=S2_1, P1413=2154=S2_2, P1414=2222=S2_3, P1416=3456=S3_1, P1417=3341=S3_2, P1418=3539=S3_3).

claims.value: 1,2,3 repeated for each of S1,S2,S3 (suffix of experiment name)
claims.evidence: Taken from the _1/_2/_3 suffix of the deposited MaxQuant experiment names; that suffixes denote biological replicates is an assumption, not stated in any deposited text.

PRIDE project description states a screen in RPE1 cells and zip archive is named RPE_APX; Cellosaurus lists RPE1 as a synonym of hTERT-RPE1 (CVCL_4388) via sdrf tools cellline lookup. That the line is the hTERT-immortalised line is inferred from the synonym.
Cellosaurus record values for CVCL_4388 (cell line donor), required by the cell-lines/human templates; not stated in the deposit.
PRIDE organism field Homo sapiens (human) and protocol text: Uniprot human database.
PRIDE organismPart 'Cell culture' is not an UBERON/BTO term; no other information in PRIDE text or deposited files.

RAW header of P1408.raw (HTTP range, first 300 kB) reads 'Q Exactive Plus - Orbitrap MS' and 'Method of Q Exactive Plus'; MaxQuant summary.txt says Q Exactive; PRIDE field says Q Exactive. Header preferred.

Protocol: label-free quantitation in MaxQuant (multiplicity 1, no labels). P1408.raw instrument-method header (HTTP range, first 300 kB) reads 'FULL MS / DD-MS2 (TOPN)', i.e. data-dependent acquisition; only P1408 header was inspected, the remaining apex runs share the same method assumed from the identical MaxQuant search.
Protocol: trypsin digestion on beads; 'Trypsin without proline restriction' = Trypsin/P in txt/summary.txt; recorded as Trypsin.

claims.value: Acetyl (Protein N-term) UNIMOD:1; Gln->pyro-Glu UNIMOD:28 (N-term Q); Glu->pyro-Glu UNIMOD:27 (N-term E); Oxidation (M) UNIMOD:35; all variable
claims.evidence: txt/parameters.txt and txt/summary.txt in RPE_APX_txt.zip list Variable modifications Acetyl (Protein N-term);Gln->pyro-Glu;Glu->pyro-Glu;Oxidation (M); no fixed modifications ('Fixed modifications' empty). Accessions verified against OLS/UNIMOD. Protocol prose lists only acetyl and oxidation.
dataProcessingProtocol: 'both precursor and MS/MS main search error set to 6 ppm'; parameters.txt in the zip does not give a precursor tolerance.
txt/parameters.txt: MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm. This conflicts with the protocol sentence (6 ppm for MS/MS); deposited search output preferred.
Not stated in PRIDE text or deposited search outputs; the inspected P1408.raw header excerpt did not show the fragmentation type, so not claimed.
One injection per raw file; no fractionation described.

claims.value: ms-proteomics v1.1.0, human v1.1.0, cell-lines v1.1.0
claims.evidence: Templates declared for human cell-line label-free MS.

limitations: Biological meaning of sample groups S1, S2, S3 (e.g. APEX2-FGF1 vs FGF1 control, plus/minus heparin, time) is not given in PRIDE text or any deposited file; the paper full text could not be read (no open full text in Europe PMC). Therefore no treatment/factor columns were added and no factor value exists.
Biological replicate numbers 1-3 follow the suffix of MaxQuant experiment names and are an assumption.

P8838.raw (MaxQuant 1.6.1.0, fixed Carbamidomethyl, phospho search, acquired 2017) is annotated in the separate PXD009302-shotgun SDRF because its deposited search settings differ from those of P1408-P1418 (MaxQuant 1.4.0.5, 2015). The two zip archives contain MaxQuant tables only, no raw files; listings were made from the zip central directories and file names claimed are the ones deposited as .raw in PRIDE.

Cell line identity hTERT-RPE1 is inferred from the 'RPE1' name via the Cellosaurus synonym; age 1Y and sex female are Cellosaurus values, not from the deposit. PRIDE also mentions U2OS-FGFR4 cells in the protocol, but none of the deposited runs could be assigned to U2OS-FGFR4.
Tolerance conflict: protocol says MS/MS 6 ppm, deposited parameters.txt says 20 ppm (20 ppm used). Protocol prose says MaxQuant 1.4.0.8, parameters.txt says 1.4.0.5.
Dissociation method, organism part, cell type, disease not available. Mass spectrometer is a Q Exactive Plus per RAW headers, whereas PRIDE lists Q Exactive.
The deposited PXD009302_community_annotated.sdrf.tsv exists (all-not-available sample info, Q Exactive, no cell line); it was consulted but not reused.
Paper not cited as a source because its full text was not read.
